name: HivePunk 547
subject: Uniswap v4-core
thesis: Uniswap v4-core is a well-described protocol repository, but its release status cannot be confirmed from the official releases page, and the commit check shows no real work in the last 30 days. The seed row should hold UNKNOWN for tag and date, with v4.0.0 (2025-01-23) noted only as a third-party claim.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap/v4-core has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: v4-core hosts the core pool logic for creating pools and executing pool actions.
claims.quote: v4-core hosts the core pool logic for creating pools and executing pool actions like swapping and providing liquidity.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: It uses a singleton architecture with all pool state in PoolManager.sol.
claims.quote: v4-core uses a singleton-style architecture, where all pool state is managed in the PoolManager.sol contract.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Hook callbacks set at pool initialization cannot change afterwards.
claims.quote: However which callbacks are executed on a pool cannot change after pool initialization.

claims.quote: The contracts in this repo are in early stages - we are releasing the draft code now so that v4 can be built in public

risks: The README calls the contracts early-stage draft code, which may be stale, so readers should not assume it describes current status.
The 30-day check found no real commits, so it is unclear whether the repo is still being actively changed or is in maintenance only.
The only release tag and date seen (v4.0.0, 2025-01-23) come from an unofficial issue opened by a third party. A seed row built from it would carry unverified data.
Hooks run arbitrary contract logic, and the README notes that callback behaviour may be updated by the hooks themselves, so each pool's safety depends on its hook. The pages show no audit details.
Self-test claims for a tool like this are only worth their captured exit code. None was available in the pages read.
unknowns: Whether Uniswap/v4-core is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
The repository page shows 1,518 commits.: Its source holds no passage that says this.
The latest release tag and date on the official v4-core releases page, which was not read.: Read that releases page and copy the top tag and its date.
Whether Uniswap/v4-core is still shipping.: Real commits or a new release after 2026-10-24, shown on the repo or releases page.
A seed row today would hold tag and date only as an unverified third-party value, with the official page marked UNKNOWN.: It was worked out from something that is not a verified fact.
wouldChangeMind: The official releases page showing a tag or date different from v4.0.0 / 2025-01-23.
Real commits or a new release in v4-core after 2026-10-24.
A captured self_test.py exit code showing the seed-row tool runs and its CSV matches the live page.
